overview:
Another TOTW performance from Try hard FC has seen them increase their lead at the top to 71pts, after it fell to 47pts last week. Yorkshire Lass UTD and Norfolk N Chance stay in 2nd and 3rd respectively whilst a decent scoring week for Under my Cucurella see them move up one place to 4th.

The global average score of 38pts was quite low this week however 18 of the 20 teams in the league managed to score higher than the average - that's impressive! Give yourself a part on the back of you were one of those teams.

I guess the story of the week was high scoring midfielders and low scoring strikers. Popular midfield picks such as Fernandes, Guimarães, Dewsbury-Hall and Foden all chipped in with goals and assists and scored double figures in FPL, whilst popular striker picks like Haaland, Thiago, Mateta and Voldemort Woltemade all blanked.

If you read down this far, well done! Don't forget, the African Cup of Nations begins this week, which means a number of players will be out for about a month. It also means we get 5 free transfers to use from GW16 onwards - use them wisely!
totwDescription: After weeks of bang average scores that saw their lead at the top diminish, Try hard FC have come out fighting for GW15 and secure their 5th TOTW of the season after scoring 77pts in GW15. It wasn't looking that way for a while, but with the last game of the weekend, captain Fernandes pulled out a POTW performance and scored 36pts for Matthew's team. Additional goals for Guéhi and Mbeumo helped secure TOTW, well done Matthew 👌🏻
sackedDescription: Wards Wanderers had a terrible week, even with their Bench Boost chip deployed they still ended up as the lowest scoring team of GW15, with 32pts. No game time for Aït-Nouri and Nyoni, plus a yellow card for Walker meant zero points for all 3 players. Cucurella was their highest scoring player with 6pts, which tells it's own story about the teams overall performance. Better luck next week, Scott 💪🏻

otherUpdates.title: 👌🏻 Player of the Week
otherUpdates.content:
Bruno Fernandes (MUN 🔴⚫ - £9.0m) with 2 goals and one assist against Wolves is this week's POTW, scoring 18pts. He is a popular player of course and is selected by 20.6% of all teams, including 3 of the 20 teams in the League of Leg Ends.

Shout out of course to Emi Buendia after scoring that last minute goal against Arsenal that saw me scare the shit out of my dog and celebrate a goal like I've never celebrated before - Absolute limbs! Am I supposed to be impartial here - oh well, UTFV 💜🩵

otherUpdates.title: ⏭️ Next Gameweek
otherUpdates.content: The deadline for locking in teams, transfers and chips for GW16 is Saturday 13th December at 1:30pm.
